story.iWant: comprehensive tests for the proactive system
story.soThat: I can confidently deploy and maintain the feature
story.tasks: - Task 1: Set up test infrastructure (backend/tests/test_proactive/ directory, pytest fixtures, freezegun for time mocking) - Task 2: Write IntentsClient tests (CRUD operations, claim conflict handling, fire reporting against mock API) - Task 3: Write evaluator tests (PriceEvaluator with mock yfinance, PortfolioEvaluator with mock portfolio, SilenceEvaluator with mock Redis) - Task 4: Write gate tests (each gate check in isolation, gate with all checks passing, defer_until calculation) - Task 5: Write agent tests (mock LLM responses, test skip decision logic, test message composition) - Task 6: Write full flow tests (mock agentic-memories, mock Telegram, test complete trigger → delivery flow) - Task 7: Write feedback tests (proactive message recording, feedback detection, context clearing)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - AC #1: Trigger Creation Tests - Create scheduled/condition triggers via MCP tools, verify stored correctly in mock agentic-memories - AC #2: Condition Evaluator Tests - Price evaluator tests <, >, <=, >= operators; Portfolio evaluator tests various expressions; Silence evaluator tests with mock activity times - AC #3: Subconscious Gate Tests - Verify recent contact blocking, daily limit blocking, quiet hours blocking, opt-out blocking - AC #4: Wake-Up Agent Tests - Verify tool calls match briefing, skip conditions respected, message matches guidelines - AC #5: Full Flow Test - Gate passes, agent executes, message "sent" (mock Telegram), fire reported correctly - AC #6: Feedback Handler Tests - Feedback context correctly detected, system prompt includes trigger context, update trigger works, context cleared after processing

story-context.constraints: - Test structure: Create backend/tests/test_proactive/ directory with __init__.py, conftest.py (fixtures), and separate test files per component - Mocking strategy: Use httpx mock for agentic-memories (IntentsClient), Mock/AsyncMock for Telegram bot, AsyncMock for LLM responses, fakeredis or mock Redis for state - Time mocking: Use freezegun for scheduled trigger tests, gate tests (quiet hours, cooldown), silence evaluator tests - Fixture organization: Component-specific fixtures in test_proactive/conftest.py, reuse backend/tests/conftest.py for global fixtures - Test markers: Use @pytest.mark.unit for isolated tests, @pytest.mark.integration for multi-component tests, @pytest.mark.asyncio for async tests - Error handling tests: MUST test fail-safe behavior (evaluators return False on error, gate blocks on error, worker doesn't crash) - Coverage target: >80% for all proactive module code (evaluators, gate, agent, worker, intents_client) - Test isolation: Each test should be independent, reset mocks between tests, use autouse fixtures for cleanup

interface.details: Test CRUD operations against mock agentic-memories API. Verify claim_intent returns 409 on conflict, fire_intent clears claim and updates counters, get_pending excludes claimed intents and includes in_cooldown flag.

interface.name: Condition Evaluators
interface.details: Test expression parsing, operator evaluation (<, >, <=, >=), data fetching (mock yfinance/portfolio/Redis), caching (60s for prices), error handling (return False on failure). Verify fail-safe behavior.

interface.name: Subconscious Gate
interface.details: Test all gate checks: recent contact (3h minimum), daily limit (max 3/day), quiet hours (10pm-8am user local time), opt-out (user disabled proactive), spam prevention. Verify defer_until calculation for blocked triggers.

interface.name: Wake-Up Agent
interface.details: Test briefing parsing, tool call execution (mock MCP client), skip conditions (LLM decides not to fire), message composition, action_context adherence. Mock LLM streaming responses.

interface.name: Proactive Feedback Handler
interface.details: Test detection of proactive message context, system prompt injection with trigger context, update_intent calls for feedback-based changes, context clearing after processing. Verify closed-loop learning.

tests.standards: - Testing framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto in pytest.ini) - Test directory: backend/tests/test_proactive/ (new directory) - Test files: test_intents_client.py, test_evaluators.py, test_gate.py, test_agent.py, test_worker.py, test_feedback.py, conftest.py - Mocking: Use unittest.mock (AsyncMock, Mock, patch), httpx for API mocking, freezegun for time - Fixtures: Component fixtures in test_proactive/conftest.py, global fixtures from backend/tests/conftest.py - Markers: @pytest.mark.unit, @pytest.mark.integration, @pytest.mark.asyncio - Naming: test_* functions, Test* classes, descriptive test names (test_evaluator_returns_false_on_yfinance_error) - Coverage: >80% for proactive module code
tests.ideas:
- AC #1 Trigger Creation Tests: * Test create_intent via MCP tool with scheduled trigger (cron mode, once mode) * Test create_intent via MCP tool with condition trigger (price, portfolio, silence) * Mock httpx POST to /v1/intents, verify payload structure * Test error handling (network error, API error) * Verify action_context is preserved in storage
- AC #2 Condition Evaluator Tests: * PriceEvaluator: Mock yfinance.Ticker().info, test <, >, <=, >= operators * PriceEvaluator: Test caching (60s TTL in Redis), verify cache hit doesn't call yfinance * PriceEvaluator: Test yfinance error returns False (fail-safe) * PriceEvaluator: Test retry with exponential backoff (mock 3 failures then success) * PortfolioEvaluator: Mock get_portfolio, test any_holding_change > 5%, any_holding_down, total_value, total_change expressions * SilenceEvaluator: Mock Redis get last_activity, use freezegun to test time thresholds * SilenceEvaluator: Test various silence periods (2h, 4h, 1d)
- AC #3 Subconscious Gate Tests: * Test recent contact check: Mock Redis last proactive message timestamp, verify 3h minimum * Test daily limit check: Mock Redis message count for today, verify max 3/day * Test quiet hours check: Use freezegun to set time to 11pm/2am/7am, verify blocking * Test opt-out check: Mock user opt-out preference, verify blocking * Test all checks passing: Verify gate allows trigger to fire * Test defer_until calculation: Verify correct timestamp for next allowed fire * Test gate error handling: Verify gate blocks on Redis error (fail-safe)
- AC #4 Wake-Up Agent Tests: * Mock LLM client streaming response, verify message composition * Mock action_context briefing, verify agent follows instructions * Mock tool calls (get_portfolio, internet_search), verify tools called as briefed * Test skip decision: Mock LLM returning skip signal, verify no message sent * Test message guideline adherence: Verify tone, length, formatting from action_context * Test error handling: Mock LLM error, verify graceful failure
- AC #5 Full Flow Tests: * Create mock environment: Mock agentic-memories (IntentsClient), Telegram (bot.send_message), LLM, Redis * Test scheduled trigger flow: Create trigger → claim → gate passes → agent executes → deliver → fire report * Test condition trigger flow: Create trigger → evaluate condition (pass) → claim → gate passes → agent executes → deliver → fire report * Test gate blocking flow: Trigger fires but gate blocks (quiet hours) → fire_intent with status=gate_blocked * Test condition not met flow: Condition evaluates to False → fire_intent with status=condition_not_met * Test claim conflict: Multiple workers claim same trigger → 409 Conflict → one succeeds
- AC #6 Feedback Handler Tests: * Test proactive message recording: Verify proactive_context stored in Redis after delivery * Test feedback detection: User replies to proactive message → context loaded from Redis * Test system prompt injection: Verify trigger context added to system prompt for follow-up * Test update_intent: User says "change this to daily" → update_intent called with new schedule * Test context clearing: After processing reply → proactive_context cleared from Redis * Test timeout: proactive_context expires after 1 hour → not detected
- Integration Test Ideas: * Test multiple triggers for same user: Verify only allowed ones fire (gate logic) * Test worker crash recovery: Claimed intent times out (5min) → available for retry * Test cooldown behavior: Condition trigger fires → cooldown active → evaluator skips for X hours * Test timezone handling: Cron triggers respect user timezone (mock pytz) * Test once mode: Trigger fires once → disabled automatically * Test max_executions: Trigger hits execution limit → disabled
- Performance Test Ideas: * Test evaluator caching reduces API calls (price cache 60s) * Test gate checks are fast (<50ms for all checks) * Test worker can process 100 pending triggers in <30s (with mocks)
- Edge Case Tests: * Test malformed expressions: Evaluator handles parse errors gracefully * Test missing Redis data: Gate handles missing activity timestamp * Test LLM timeout: Agent handles streaming timeout gracefully * Test Telegram delivery failure: Worker retries or reports failure * Test action_context too large: Verify truncation or error handling * Test user deleted mid-execution: Handle gracefully

architecture.overview: Proactive AI system implements LLM-driven architecture with two LLMs (Creation LLM and Wake-Up LLM) connected via rich action_context briefing. Tests must validate this handoff and ensure: 1. IntentsClient correctly interfaces with agentic-memories Intents API 2. Evaluators quickly and safely evaluate conditions (fail-safe on error) 3. Subconscious gate prevents spam and respects user preferences 4. Wake-Up agent follows briefing instructions and uses tools appropriately 5. Full flow from trigger creation → evaluation → gate → execution → delivery works end-to-end 6. Feedback loop enables closed-loop learning and trigger updates
architecture.components: - IntentsClient (Story 13.1): HTTP client for agentic-memories /v1/intents API - CRUD, claim, fire, get_pending - MCP Tools (Story 13.2): create_trigger, list_triggers, update_trigger, delete_trigger, get_trigger tools - System Prompt (Story 13.3): Enhanced system prompt with proactive capabilities and briefing context - Evaluators (Story 13.4): PriceEvaluator, PortfolioEvaluator, SilenceEvaluator - fast condition checks - Subconscious Gate (Story 13.5): Gate with 4 checks (recent contact, daily limit, quiet hours, opt-out) - Wake-Up Agent (Story 13.6): LLM agent that reads briefing, calls tools, composes message - ARQ Worker (Story 13.7): Background worker using arq for async task processing - Activity Tracking (Story 13.8): Redis-based user activity tracking for silence detection - Telegram Delivery (Story 13.9): Integration with Telegram bot for message delivery - Feedback Handler (Story 13.10): Detects proactive context and enables closed-loop learning
architecture.flowDiagram:
FULL TRIGGER EXECUTION FLOW (for testing):
1. CREATION (User creates trigger via chat) User: "Remind me every Friday at 5pm to review my portfolio" ↓ LLM calls create_trigger MCP tool ↓ IntentsClient.create_intent() → POST /v1/intents ↓ Trigger stored in agentic-memories
2. POLLING (Worker checks for due triggers) Worker: IntentsClient.get_pending() → GET /v1/intents/pending ↓ Returns triggers due for execution (excludes claimed, includes in_cooldown flag)
3. CLAIMING (Worker claims trigger for exclusive processing) Worker: IntentsClient.claim_intent(id) → POST /v1/intents/{id}/claim ↓ Returns 200 OK with claimed_at timestamp OR 409 Conflict if already claimed (race condition)
4. EVALUATION (For condition triggers only) Worker: Evaluator.evaluate(condition) ↓ Fetch data (yfinance, portfolio, Redis activity) ↓ Compare against expression ↓ Return True/False (False on error - fail-safe)
5. GATE CHECK (Spam prevention) Worker: SubconsciousGate.should_fire(trigger, user_id) ↓ Check: Recent contact (3h minimum) Check: Daily limit (max 3/day) Check: Quiet hours (10pm-8am user local time) Check: Opt-out (user disabled proactive) ↓ Return GateResult(allowed: bool, reason: str, defer_until: datetime)
6. EXECUTION (Wake-up LLM generates message) Worker: WakeUpAgent.execute(trigger) ↓ Read action_context briefing ↓ Call tools (get_portfolio, internet_search, etc.) ↓ Stream LLM response with briefing + tool results ↓ Compose final message
7. DELIVERY (Send to Telegram) Worker: TelegramClient.send_message(user_id, message) ↓ Store proactive_context in Redis (for feedback detection) ↓ Return message_id
8. REPORTING (Report execution to agentic-memories) Worker: IntentsClient.fire_intent(id, report) ↓ POST /v1/intents/{id}/fire with status (success/failed/gate_blocked/condition_not_met) ↓ Clears claimed_at, updates execution_count, last_executed ↓ Returns cooldown status for condition triggers
9. FEEDBACK (User replies to proactive message - closed-loop learning) User replies to proactive message ↓ Chat endpoint detects proactive_context in Redis ↓ System prompt injected with trigger context ↓ LLM can call update_trigger if user wants changes ↓ Clear proactive_context after processing
